instruction: Six black obsidian swords stand planted upright in the marsh around the blindfolded woman: three on her left and three on her right. Add exactly TWO more identical swords: one more on the left, standing at the far left with a clear gap from the others, and one more on the right, standing at the far right with a clear gap, each fully visible with its own bronze hilt. Do not change the six swords already there. The finished painting shows exactly eight swords, four on each side.
